note: Functions N64Recomp refuses (found by running it, see README 'Acceptance'), and what the config does with each. stub: emitted as an empty body (the operation has no host meaning). ignored: not emitted; the runtime must provide a host function of the same name (Phase 1 shim list). Names are inventory names (static population). renamed: emitted as NAME_recomp because NAME collides with a host C/libc declaration (found by compiling the output with clang). instruction: single-word replacements (N64Recomp [[patches.instruction]]); the hand-written codec kernels get their PC with a never-taken `bltzal zero` whose only effect is ra = pc+8, which N64Recomp treats as a call into the inline table; the pair is rewritten to load the same ra value directly (lui/ori), behaviour unchanged.
